sections.heading: ShipBob at a glance
sections.body: E-commerce fulfillment platform that helps businesses manage inventory, pack, and ship orders to customers efficiently.

sections.heading: Where it may fit in a shortlist
sections.body: Based on its positioning under Commerce, ShipBob is most relevant during early market discovery. The available record includes 10 category signals and 12 commercial records, giving buyers a starting point—not a substitute for requirements validation.

sections.heading: Questions to ask before buying
sections.body: Ask ShipBob for a workflow-specific demonstration, itemized pricing, implementation responsibilities, data-processing terms, support response targets, and references from organizations with a similar scale and use case.

sections.heading: Our research perspective
sections.body: The strongest signal in this assessment is audience fit; the area requiring the most buyer diligence is product clarity. These signals describe documentation quality and should not be read as measured product performance.

faq.question: How is the ShipBob score calculated?
faq.answer: The research score weights product clarity (28%), audience fit (24%), buyer access (18%), buying detail (18%), and record confidence (12%). It evaluates available buying information, not product performance.
